text:
Situation: Cyclophosphamide supply is tight. Corvale East holds 54 units (20.4 days on hand) and Corvale General holds 62.67 units (21.9 days on hand). The current Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC label is manufactured at Jiangsu Hengrui Pharmaceuticals Co., Ltd. (Jinqiao Road Site).

Why (FDA record): FDA inspection 1053330 at the Jiangsu Hengrui plant ended 2018-04-13 and was classified VAI, classification known 2018-06-14. FDA inspection 1319132 at the same plant ended 2026-04-15 and was classified VAI, classification known 2026-07-14. As of 2026-10-21, cyclophosphamide is not on the FDA drug shortage list.

Our position: Current inventory provides approximately three weeks of supply. No FDA shortage listing exists. Alternative manufacturers have product available and are not on the FDA shortage list.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to evaluate and place orders with Avenacy, LLC (plant: EPIC PHARMA LLC); requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.
2. Buyer to evaluate and place orders with Avyxa Pharma, LLC (plant: Dr. Reddys Laboratories Limited, last inspection VAI 2024-05-17); requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.
3. Buyer to evaluate and place orders with Baxter Healthcare Company (plant: Baxter Healthcare Corporation Deerfield); requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.
4. Buyer to evaluate and place orders with Epic Pharma, LLC (plant: EPIC PHARMA LLC); requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.
5. Buyer to evaluate and place orders with Sagent Pharmaceuticals (plant: SAGENT PHARMS INC.); requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.

Not recommended: Delaying procurement until inventory falls below 14 days on hand.
